cohort: The participants were newborns diagnosed with Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE).
finding: The study found that HIE Newborn incidence was higher in 18-23 year old primigravidae with maternal anemia and low socioeconomic status, and was significantly associated with prolonged and obstructed labor, male babies, meconium stained liquor, oligohydramnios, and a 5-minute APGAR score of less than seven.
